notes.title: Celebrate Launch Day With Us!
notes.content:
[img]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/LaunchDayUpdate.jpg[/img]

They’ve been put through the paces of Steam’s Early Access and now these 14 Martial Arts Stuntmen are ready to go toe-to-toe and earn a starring role on the official Steam Storefront! Join us in celebrating Kings of Kung Fu’s exit from Early Access TODAY where it has officially launched on Steam, for PC, Mac and Linux with a celebratory 50% discount (limited time only).

[h1]Launch Update[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Added 2 new characters: Jane Fury & Shen Wu
   [*]Added new stage and music: Rural
   [*]Revised and fixed many animations for older characters
   [*]Revised the hit location zones for all attacks
   [*]Optimized textures and music tracks for game
   [*]Added new moves for a few of the older characters
   [*]Randomized all of the opponents for the arcade mode
   [*]Added new win screen poster
   [*]Tweaked various moves and throws
[/list]

notes.title: Final Stretch before busting out of EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
[img]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/LeavingEarlyAccessUpdate.jpg[/img]

This is it Kung Fu fans, we’re gearing up to head out of Early Access and we wanted to take a moment to bow down and thank each and every one of you for joining Jae Lee Productions on this journey of bringing his love letter to Kung Fu cinema to life.

You have been here through the crashes and updates sharing your feedback and suggestions, and we cannot thank you enough for your support. In the world of indie development it is rough to put your baby out there for others to accept while balancing your vision and resources with the wishes and desires of what the public wants your baby to be.

While we couldn’t implement everyone’s ideas into the game we are proud of what we’ve been able to accomplish with such finite resources and a lot of that is thanks to you. And fear not! As we head out of Early Access, work on the game will not cease - New Stages and Characters are still in the works! Given that the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316930/discussions/0/626329186820873489/]“New Fighter Requests/Suggestions”[/url] thread is still the most popular and active thread we know you want to see more stuntmen based on your favorite characters/martial artists. Again, [i]SO MANY GREAT SUGGESTIONS![/i]

You should all be proud of your contributions and join us in celebrating and promoting the game when it officially launches at the end of June. If you have a YOUTUBE Channel, post up your Let’s Plays and Strategy videos! Do you stream on TWITCH? Awesome, share your links and tweets with us all so we can join you!

If you tweet out links to your videos and streams be sure to add [url=https://twitter.com/dtribegames]@dtribegames[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/kingsofkungfu]@kingsofkungfu[/url] so we can check them out and retweet your links.

So what all can you expect on launch day? 
[LIST]
   [*]Two new fighters
   [*]The long awaited Kings of Kung Fu OST
   [*]Tweaks, fixes, and optimization
[/LIST]
Support will continue out past launch with Trading Cards and even more characters planned in the months to come.

Sincerely, thanks again. [B]Everyone keep on Kung Fu fighting![/B]

The long awaited Kings of Kung Fu OST

notes.title: Our Community Kicks Butt!
notes.content:
[img]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Update-Community.jpg[/img]
I just wanted to take a moment to thank everyone who has been here since day one of Early Access, and those of you just finding your way here via the recent sale.  It has been a fun journey to take with all of you, and before too long it will be coming to an end. An official launch is just months away, and we owe a lot to you, the community, for sharing all the love, bugs, issues, suggestions, wishlists, thoughts, stories and everything else.

As Jae Lee and any indie dev can tell you, it is hard to open up your baby to the criticizing eyes and hands of the public. 

Kings of Kung Fu: Masters of the Art, was, is and will be Jae's passion project to bring his love of classic kung fu movies and old school fighting games into one fun playable form. As Jae said from the beginning:

[i]"Kings of Kung Fu is mainly a love letter to kung fu cinema firstly and a casual to mid core fighter secondly. The game is a small, indie passion project aimed to provide fun while honoring the films I have always loved. Feedback from the community will help make this a better game. 

I don't want to give the false impression that it will become a fighter for the hardcore fighting game community. I appreciate the support and feedback and will continue to update the game with your feedback in mind." [/i]

Since the game hit Early Access we've seen a number of improvements come along. 

[h1]Update 3.0[/h1]
[i]released: 03/25/2015[/i]
[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
  [*]edited block proximity for all attacks 
  [*]now possible to back dash out of blocks (double tap back) 
  [*]fixed incorrect input commands on character move lists
[/list]
[u]Additions[/u]
  [*]added very easy difficulty 
  [*]added 4 characters 
  [*]added 2 stages 
  [*]added new music
[/list]

[h1]Update 2.0[/h1]
[i]released: 02/20/2015[/i]
[list]
   [*]Added support for more resolutions
   [*]Fixed the sensitive directional control issue
   [*]Edited control responsiveness moves less delayed
   [*]Slowed the game speed down a bit
   [*]Rebalanced a few moves
   [*]Added a crane kick for Lo Wei (Down + LK)
   [*]Added 1 inch punch for Tao lung (Down + Fwd + LP)
   [*]Readjusted the collision boxes for attacks
   [*]Fixed the exploits for Tao Lung, Chen fu and Lo Wei
   [*]Corrected the command display for John Deux's nut cracker punch
   [*]Added loading bar to PC build
   [*]Tweaked a few character animations 
   [*]Optimized the stages and characters for the pc build
   [*]Fixed the mirror match issue
   [*]Fixed the achievement low health issue
   [*]Made is easier to perform chain and link combos
   [*]Note - dashes are invincible
   [*]Added the 4 character slots for the up coming characters
[/list]
Note: for the PC users the controls may become mixed up after the update if so it is recommended to reset to the default controls in the options menu. You can then reassign the buttons to your liking.

For PC users after the patch update loading may be a bit longer during the initial launch.

[h1]Update 1.0[/h1]
[i]released: 12/18/2014[/i]
[list]
   [*]Infinite combos with Tao Lung, Ju Mao and Ron Jones have been removed.
   [*]Chang Tai can now throw the boss character without crashing the game.
   [*]The Japanese war flag has been removed from the Dojo stage due to cultural sensitivity
   [*]Analog control support has been added - new controller configuration options in the options menu
   [*]The announcer can be turned off during game play.
   [*]The option to disable/enable the full screen effects has been added to the options menu.
   [*]Fixed the frame rate for the Shaolin and Bamboo stages
   [*]Black screen issue where only the HUD images were being displayed can be fixed by disabling the old movie effect in the options menu.
[/list]

[h1]More to Come![/h1]
From here there are still some things coming down the pipeline as we get ready for launch and beyond.
[list]
  [*]Revamping the menus and loading screens
  [*]Unique Ending screens for each fighter
  [*]Continual tweaks and balances to fix existing issues
  [*]Trading Cards
  [*]Additional Characters
  [*]New music tracks
  [*]Kings of Kung Fu OST
[/list]
Again, thank you all for the praise and the tough love! 

Keep the conversations going in the forums. Keep sharing your videos, guides, screens and thoughts with us all. Be sure to follow Jae Lee on Twitter @KingsOfKungFu as well as Digital Tribe Games @dtribegames and 'Like Us' on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/DigitalTribeGames

notes.title: Patch update 2.0 is live
notes.content:
[img]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/KoKF-Update-2-0.jpg[/img]
A big thank you to the growing community for providing such great feedback. Keep up the great communication and we'll keep working on fine tuning the game! 

[i]NOTE: Before you install please delete the local game content from steam and do a clean install.[/i] 

Here are the fixes and additions featured in the second patch. 
[list]
   [*]Added support for more resolutions
   [*]Fixed the sensitive directional control issue
   [*]Edited control responsiveness moves less delayed
   [*]Slowed the game speed down a bit
   [*]Rebalanced a few moves
   [*]Added a crane kick for Lo Wei (Down + LK)
   [*]Added 1 inch punch for Tao lung (Down + Fwd + LP)
   [*]Readjusted the collision boxes for attacks
   [*]Fixed the exploits for Tao Lung, Chen fu and Lo Wei
   [*]Corrected the command display for John Deux's nut cracker punch
   [*]Added loading bar to PC build
   [*]Tweaked a few character animations 
   [*]Optimized the stages and characters for the pc build
   [*]Fixed the mirror match issue
   [*]Fixed the achievement low health issue
   [*]Made is easier to perform chain and link combos
   [*]Note - dashes are invincible
   [*]Added the 4 character slots for the up coming characters
[/list]
Note: for the PC users the controls may become mixed up after the update if so it is recommended to reset to the default controls in the options menu. You can then reassign the buttons to your liking.

For PC users after the patch update loading may be a bit longer during the initial launch.

notes.title: Update 1.0 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/Steam-Update-1.png[/img]
The first of many updates has now gone live! A big thank you to the growing community for providing such great feedback. Keep up the great communication and we'll keep working on fine tuning the game!

[i]NOTE: Before you install please delete the local game content from steam and do a clean install.[/i]

Here are the fixes and additions featured in the first patch.
[olist]
   [*] Infinite combos with Tao Lung, Ju Mao and Ron Jones have been removed.
   [*] Chang Tai can now throw the boss character without crashing the game.
   [*] The Japanese war flag has been removed from the Dojo stage due to cultural sensitivity
   [*] Analog control support has been added - new controller configuration options in the options menu
   [*] The announcer can be turned off during game play.
   [*] The option to disable/enable the full screen effects has been added to the options menu.
   [*] Fixed the frame rate for the Shaolin and Bamboo stages
[/olist]
We're still working on the mirror match issue in the story mode and other issues like the black screen issue. During our time working on this patch we discovered that the white screen/crash issue is caused by a Ram cap issue in 32bit operating systems. The crashing also seems to happen with older graphics cards that have less than 1GB of Ram. We are working on ways to mitigate these issues and will keep you updated.

Stay tuned for the expanded roster announcement sometime next week :)

The announcer can be turned off during game play.
The option to disable/enable the full screen effects has been added to the options menu.
